description: A middleware that is a defect by existing. errorhandler answers a failed request with the stack trace, the source line and the local variables, and its own documentation says development only -- so there is nothing in the call to inspect and no way to call it safely. Whether NODE_ENV guards it is a deployment fact, not a property of the source. The negative is the production handler beside it, which answers with a status and nothing else.

expected.note: measured at two across the vulnerable corpus, both of them findings a recall audit named, and none at all across twenty-eight production repositories
